title: Re-add StudyActivityChart with proper webpack config
body: The chart was removed because recharts@3.x pulls in @napi-rs/canvas (native Node.js binary) through victory-vendor, causing webpack browser build failures. The canvas issue is fixed by serverExternalPackages (already in next.config.js). The remaining issue is the .node alias caused HookWebpackError. If recharts is needed in a future PR, try: (1) Keep undici and node:false fallback in webpack config, (2) Skip the .node alias entirely since serverExternalPackages handles canvas, (3) Test the build before merging.
rationale: The stats page chart is a valuable UX feature that was in task 2447. It should be re-implemented properly in a follow-up PR.
